patches.value: For i,j in I, E_ij is the unique complex linear operator sending e_j to e_i and sending e_k to 0 for every k in I with k!=j. It is defined using the complex basis (e_i) indexed by I.

rho is the action induced by the lattice operators: for t in {x,y,h}, rho(t tensor 1)(m tensor c)=(tm) tensor c, extended K-linearly to L_K. The action is defined when the lattice operators preserve M and satisfy the Chevalley relations.
